question: To what kind of person, characterized as endowed with all states and as one of resolved decision, must something be given?
premises: Something is designated as to be given.
The recipient is one endowed with all states.
The recipient is also one of resolved decision.
inference: Something is to be given to one endowed with all states and of resolved decision.
uncertainties: Nature of what is to be given not specified
plain_english: It is to be given to one endowed with all states and of resolved decision.
